id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|187c: "I am the chief of the Yubar tribe. You are a traveler, aren't you. Welcome.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1940: "Normally it is our tribe's custom to welcome travelers courteously, but we cannot afford that now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a40: "Lyla, a dancer of the Yubar tribe, was attacked by a sudden monster and stricken with a mysterious illness.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b40: "We Yubar folk offered prayer dances and tried every medicine, but Lyla's illness has not improved at all.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c48: "Worse, her husband Kiefer set out to find a jewel that heals any illness and hasn't returned for days.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d64: "My son-in-law is skilled, yet taking this long means something may have happened to him...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e50: "I gather you came here after a long journey? Then you must be highly skilled.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f20: "Could you help find Kiefer and search for the jewel that can heal her?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|205c: "...I see. Sorry to ask the impossible.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2154: "...How kind of you! My son-in-law said he was going to the quarry where the jewel that heals any illness lies.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2244: "He said he'd look for a green jewel among jewels of many colors. I hope that serves as a clue...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|261c: "He said he'd look for a green jewel among jewels of many colors. I hope that serves as a clue...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2340: "Then I leave it to you, traveler. Please find Kiefer and save Lyla's life.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2718: "Then I leave it to you, traveler. Please find Kiefer and save Lyla's life.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24a4: "If Kiefer doesn't return, Lyla's life... We must absolutely avoid that!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|255c: "Kiefer said he was going to the quarry, where a jewel that heals any illness lies.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28ec: "Traveler, well done! Thanks to you my son-in-law returned safely and Lyla is well again!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29bc: "When we used the jewel my son-in-law brought back, Lyla's illness cleared up like it was a lie.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a98: "It's modest, but on behalf of the Yubar people I prepared a gift. Please accept it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b74: "Also, the green jewel my son-in-law brought back had a mysterious password engraved on it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c50: "It might mean something, so I'll tell you that password.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d48: The Yubar tribe's night camp at⏎Eden's altar seems to be open.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e54: "Protecting Lyla, the Yubar dancer, is the duty of Kiefer, who became a Yubar guardian.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f0c: "At first he looked like a flighty young man and there was much trouble, but now he fulfills that duty admirably.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff8: "My son-in-law is now a fine Yubar guardian. Together as a couple, they'll face any hardship and lead the Yubar people.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3238: "I heard everything from my husband. They say you're why I got well.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32d0: "My husband charges ahead once he sets his mind to it and can lose sight of everything. You must have had trouble.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|339c: "Thank you truly for helping my husband. Please come again anytime.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|346c: "Since we met, Kiefer has always put me first.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3508: "Because he's by my side, I can do my important duty as a Yubar dancer.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3664: "Big brother Kiefer is a Yubar guardian. His job is to protect Lyla, who can dance for the gods.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3724: "When he left the village, he said, 'I'll save Lyla.'
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37a8: "A Yubar guardian always keeps his promises. I believe in him.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3890: "Hooray! Hooray! Big brother Kiefer is amazing! He saved our Lyla!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3918: "Big brother Kiefer said you fought monsters as his underling too, traveler! Wow!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a5c: "The dance I'm doing now is the Yubar tribe's prayer dance for healing. I hope my dance reaches the gods...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b84: "Sigh. Lyla's dance really is nothing like ours. It's enchanting.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cac: "Her husband Kiefer rushed out of the village swearing to save Lyla.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d34: "I'd never seen that carefree guy look so pained. Poor thing...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3de4: "Kiefer's grinning. Well, no wonder. He's happy Lyla's well.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ef8: "Oh, a traveler, how rare. Sorry, but there's nothing I can do for you now...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fa8: "Lyla, the Yubar dancer, collapsed with some unknown illness. I'm offering a prayer dance for her.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40c0: "I hear you found and helped Kiefer, traveler.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4124: "Thanks to you, Lyla's well! She can dance again! Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4254: "Kiefer and Lyla married after a great love. They always lived happily together.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|431c: "And then this happens... The gods are cruel.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43c8: "Kiefer and Lyla married after a great love. They care deeply for each other.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|448c: "I hope they keep living happily and close forever.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4800: "Lyla is our precious Yubar dancer! We must never let her die!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|489c: "So we offer a prayer dance to the gods, begging them to heal Lyla's illness.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4984: "Ha ha ha! Lyla's well, great! My tula is happy too!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a94: "Sniff... I'm dancing hard, but Lyla isn't getting better.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b24: "Maybe it doesn't reach the gods unless the dance is skilled like Lyla's... sniff.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c08: "Sniff... Even clumsy dancers like us, the gods are watching our prayer dance.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4cbc: "I'm so glad Lyla's illness is better... sniff.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4df0: "Hey! Good to see you, traveler! My wife is well again and can dance.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50c4: "Hey! Good to see you, traveler! My wife is well again and can dance.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4eb0: "Lyla is the precious Yubar dancer. I'm here to protect her. I'm so glad she recovered.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5184: "Lyla is the precious Yubar dancer. I'm here to protect her. I'm so glad she recovered.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f88: "It's all thanks to you. Thanks a lot!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|525c: "By the way... you look like you want to ask something. Did you need me?

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5330: "Then fine. Thank you for saving Lyla!

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c84: "The tula doesn't sound, so we express that sacred sound with our voices...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6df0: "The earth tula's repair is done, and with the leftover golden mane we could repair all the tulas.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6eb8: "As a result the tones are lovelier than ever and the dancers' moves keep getting sharper.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f88: "Thank you. Now the Yubar people's prayers will never cease and will be passed to the next age.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71bc: "Oh, long time no see, traveler. You must be surprised at our strange state, unlike before.

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c64: "I want to be a tula player when I grow up and practiced a lot, but at this rate I can't.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d48: "Hee hee! The tula's fixed, so I started practicing again!

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|92b8: "This is the Yubar tribe's camp. Right now dancers dance to the tula's tone at a sacred feast.

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|945c: "We're making do with the air tula, where the player's voice is the instrument. Jan! Jagajan!

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9644: "How do you like my tula playing? Heart-touching, best tone, right?

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9824: "And if we gulp Viva Grape, the Yubar people's water of life, we get merry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|990c: "Since you came to the Yubar camp, enjoy the heart-dancing tula!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|99b0: "Of course the feast companion is Viva Grape, the Yubar water of life! Gulp it down for the best mood!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9b1c: "Normal tulas can just be fixed, but cutting the strings of the sacred earth tula is a catastrophe.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9be4: "It's a sacred treasure of the Yubar people, used in special rituals to revive the gods.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c98: "A small traveler who once stopped by brought it with great effort, and someone did this cruelty...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9db8: "You brought the golden mane, didn't you? Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e40: "You and the small traveler who came before, young folks these days are reliable.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a170: "The tula strings were cut and the chief tells us to manage with the air tula, that's unreasonable~.

id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a300: "Listen to this tone! I feel like a tula master. It feels great~.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a42c: "Traveler, long time no see. Have you met Kiefer and Lyla yet? If not, please do.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a4c8: "Problems keep coming in Yubar lately, and the two seem worn out. Please hear them out.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a5ac: "Dancing freely is truly fun. Somehow I'm tearing up... It's thanks to you, sniff.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a74c: "Oh, long time no see, traveler. Even with me as a Yubar guardian, it's embarrassing, but...

tm.「わしは ユバール族の長を務める者。\n そなたは 旅の方ですな。\n よくぞ: "I am the chief of the Yubar tribe. You are a traveler, aren't you. Welcome.
tm.「本来ならば 旅の方を 丁重に\n お迎えするのが 我ら一族のならわしじゃが\n: "Normally it is our tribe's custom to welcome travelers courteously, but we cannot afford that now.
tm.「じつは ユバール族の踊り手である ライラが\n 突如 現れた 魔物に襲われ\n: "Lyla, a dancer of the Yubar tribe, was attacked by a sudden monster and stricken with a mysterious illness.
tm.「我ら ユバールの民も 祈りの踊りを捧げ\n あらゆる薬を試し 手を尽くしました: "We Yubar folk offered prayer dances and tried every medicine, but Lyla's illness has not improved at all.
tm.「さらには ライラの夫の キーファという若者が\n どんな病も治せる 宝玉を採り: "Worse, her husband Kiefer set out to find a jewel that heals any illness and hasn't returned for days.
tm.「ムコ殿は ウデの立つ男であるのに\n こんなにも時間が かかるということは\n: "My son-in-law is skilled, yet taking this long means something may have happened to him...
tm.「察するに そなたは 長い旅をして\n ここに たどり着いたのじゃろう？\n と: "I gather you came here after a long journey? Then you must be highly skilled.
tm.「キーファを見つけだし 病を治せる宝玉を探す\n 手伝いをしては もらえんじゃろ: "Could you help find Kiefer and search for the jewel that can heal her?
tm.「……そうですか。\n ムリを言って すまなかったのう。: "...I see. Sorry to ask the impossible.
tm.「……なんと ご親切に！\n ムコ殿は どんな病も治せる宝玉がある\n 採掘場に: "...How kind of you! My son-in-law said he was going to the quarry where the jewel that heals any illness lies.
tm.「なんでも いろんな色の宝玉の中から\n 緑色をした宝玉を 探すとかなんとか……: "He said he'd look for a green jewel among jewels of many colors. I hope that serves as a clue...
tm.「それでは まかせましたぞ 旅の方。\n どうか キーファを見つけだし\n ライ: "Then I leave it to you, traveler. Please find Kiefer and save Lyla's life.
tm.「このまま キーファが戻らねば\n ライラの命は もう……。\n それだけは 絶: "If Kiefer doesn't return, Lyla's life... We must absolutely avoid that!
tm.「キーファは どんな病も治せる宝玉がある\n 採掘場に行くと 申しておりました。: "Kiefer said he was going to the quarry, where a jewel that heals any illness lies.
tm.「旅の方 よく やってくださった！\n そなたのおかげで 無事にムコ殿は戻り\n: "Traveler, well done! Thanks to you my son-in-law returned safely and Lyla is well again!
tm.「ムコ殿が持ち帰った 宝玉を使ったら\n ライラの病は ウソのように\n きれい: "When we used the jewel my son-in-law brought back, Lyla's illness cleared up like it was a lie.
tm.「ささやかですが ユバールの民を代表して\n お礼の品を 用意いたしました。\n: "It's modest, but on behalf of the Yubar people I prepared a gift. Please accept it.
tm.「それから ムコ殿が持ちかえった\n 緑色の宝玉には 不思議な合言葉が\n 刻ま: "Also, the green jewel my son-in-law brought back had a mysterious password engraved on it.
tm.「何か意味が あるかもしれませんし\n その合言葉を そなたに教えてあげましょう: "It might mean something, so I'll tell you that password.
tm.エデンの祭壇の\n夜のユバール族の休息地が 解放されたようだ。: The Yubar tribe's night camp at⏎Eden's altar seems to be open.
tm.「ユバールの踊り手である ライラを守るのが\n ユバールの守り手となった キーフ: "Protecting Lyla, the Yubar dancer, is the duty of Kiefer, who became a Yubar guardian.
tm.「最初は 軽そうな若者に見えたし\n いろいろと もめごともあったが\n 今では: "At first he looked like a flighty young man and there was much trouble, but now he fulfills that duty admirably.
tm.「今のムコ殿は 立派な ユバールの守り手。\n 夫婦で どんな困難にも 立ち向か: "My son-in-law is now a fine Yubar guardian. Together as a couple, they'll face any hardship and lead the Yubar people.
tm.「夫から すべて 聞いたわ。\n 私の病が治ったのは あなたのおかげだそうね。: "I heard everything from my husband. They say you're why I got well.
tm.「夫は 思いたったら 一直線で\n 周りが 見えなくなることがあるから\n あな: "My husband charges ahead once he sets his mind to it and can lose sight of everything. You must have had trouble.
tm.「夫を助けてくださって 本当にありがとう。\n また いつでも いらしてね。: "Thank you truly for helping my husband. Please come again anytime.
tm.「キーファは出会った時から 変わらず\n 私のことを いちばんに考えてくれている: "Since we met, Kiefer has always put me first.
tm.「あの人が そばにいてくれるから\n 私は ユバールの踊り手という\n 大切なお: "Because he's by my side, I can do my important duty as a Yubar dancer.
tm.「キーファ兄ちゃんは ユバールの守り手でね。\n 神さまに ささげるおどりを お: "Big brother Kiefer is a Yubar guardian. His job is to protect Lyla, who can dance for the gods.
tm.「村を出る時 兄ちゃんは 言ってたんだ。\n ライラは オレが たすけるって。: "When he left the village, he said, 'I'll save Lyla.'
tm.「ユバールの守り手は どんな時でも\n やくそくを ぜったいに守るんだよ。\n: "A Yubar guardian always keeps his promises. I believe in him.
tm.「わーいっ！ わーいっ！\n やっぱり キーファ兄ちゃんは スゴイや！\n ボク: "Hooray! Hooray! Big brother Kiefer is amazing! He saved our Lyla!
tm.「キーファ兄ちゃんが 言ってたよー！\n 旅人さんも キーファ兄ちゃんの子分とし: "Big brother Kiefer said you fought monsters as his underling too, traveler! Wow!
tm.「今 踊っているのは 病の回復を願う\n ユバール族の 祈りの踊りよ。\n 私の: "The dance I'm doing now is the Yubar tribe's prayer dance for healing. I hope my dance reaches the gods...
tm.「はあ……。やっぱり ライラの踊りは\n 私たちとは 全然 違うわねえ。\n ほ: "Sigh. Lyla's dance really is nothing like ours. It's enchanting.
tm.「ライラを助けるって 息まいて\n 夫のキーファが 村を飛びだしていったんだ。: "Her husband Kiefer rushed out of the village swearing to save Lyla.
tm.「いつも ひょうひょうとしてる アイツの\n つらそうなカオなんて はじめて見た: "I'd never seen that carefree guy look so pained. Poor thing...
tm.「キーファのヤツ にやけてるなあ。\n そりゃまあ ムリもないか。\n ライラが: "Kiefer's grinning. Well, no wonder. He's happy Lyla's well.
tm.「あら 旅人さんとは めずらしい。\n せっかく 来てくれたのに 悪いんだけど\: "Oh, a traveler, how rare. Sorry, but there's nothing I can do for you now...
tm.「ユバールの踊り手 ライラが\n よくわからない病で 倒れちまってね。\n あの: "Lyla, the Yubar dancer, collapsed with some unknown illness. I'm offering a prayer dance for her.
tm.「旅人さんが キーファを見つけて\n 助けてくれたんだってね。: "I hear you found and helped Kiefer, traveler.
tm.「ライラは おかげさまで あの通り！\n ダンスを踊れるくらい 元気になったよ！: "Thanks to you, Lyla's well! She can dance again! Thank you so much.
tm.「キーファと ライラは\n 大恋愛の末に 一緒になった夫婦でね。\n いつも 仲: "Kiefer and Lyla married after a great love. They always lived happily together.
tm.「それなのに こんなことになるなんて……。\n 神さまってのは いじわるだね。: "And then this happens... The gods are cruel.
tm.「キーファと ライラは\n 大恋愛の末に 一緒になった夫婦でね。\n お互い と: "Kiefer and Lyla married after a great love. They care deeply for each other.
tm.「ふたりとも いつまでも幸せに\n 仲良く 暮らしていってほしいものだねえ。: "I hope they keep living happily and close forever.
tm.「ライラは 僕らの大切な ユバールの踊り手！\n 決して 死なせるわけには いか: "Lyla is our precious Yubar dancer! We must never let her die!
tm.「だから 僕らは 神さまに\n 祈りの踊りを 捧げているのさ。\n どうか ライ: "So we offer a prayer dance to the gods, begging them to heal Lyla's illness.
tm.「わっはっは わっはっは。\n ライラが元気になって よかったなあ！\n オレの: "Ha ha ha! Lyla's well, great! My tula is happy too!
tm.「グスッ……。私 一生懸命 踊ってるけど\n ライラさんが 元気にならないの。: "Sniff... I'm dancing hard, but Lyla isn't getting better.
tm.「やっぱり ライラさんみたいに\n 上手な踊りじゃないと 神さまには\n 届かな: "Maybe it doesn't reach the gods unless the dance is skilled like Lyla's... sniff.
tm.「グスッ……。私たちみたいに\n ヘタクソな踊り子の 祈りの踊りでも\n 神さま: "Sniff... Even clumsy dancers like us, the gods are watching our prayer dance.
tm.「ライラさんの 病気が よくなって\n 本当に よかったわ……グスン。: "I'm so glad Lyla's illness is better... sniff.
tm.「おっ！ よく来たな 旅人さん！\n オレのヨメさん すっかり 元気になって\n: "Hey! Good to see you, traveler! My wife is well again and can dance.
tm.「ライラは 大切なユバールの踊り手……\n あいつを守るために オレは ここにい: "Lyla is the precious Yubar dancer. I'm here to protect her. I'm so glad she recovered.
tm.「全部 アンタの おかげだ。\n 本当に ありがとうな！: "It's all thanks to you. Thanks a lot!
tm.「ところで……何か聞きたそうなカオだけど\n オレに 用でもあったのか？: "By the way... you look like you want to ask something. Did you need me?
tm.「それなら いいんだけどさ。\n ライラのこと 助けてくれて\n 本当に ありが: "Then fine. Thank you for saving Lyla!
tm.「サマルトリアの王子ってヤツが\n オレの所に 来なかったかだって……？: "A guy called the Prince of Cannock came to me, you say...?
tm.「ちょうど さっき のんびりしたヤツが来て\n あなたは まさか ローレシアの王: "Just now an easygoing guy came and asked if I wasn't the Prince of Midenhall.
tm.「たしかに もともとは 王子には違いないが\n オレは グランエスタードの王子だ: "I was a prince, sure, but when I said I'm the Prince of Gran Estard he looked dejected.
tm.「……それでさ その のんびりしたヤツは\n うわごとのように パデキアの洞くつ: "...Then that easygoing guy murmured like he was raving, 'Maybe I'll go to Padequia Cave and look for the princess first,' and...
tm.「いきなり オレの目の前から\n パッと姿を消しちまったんだよ！\n あいつ い: "He suddenly vanished right before my eyes! Who was that guy?
tm.「どうだ ライラの踊りは すごいだろ？\n これだけ 魅力的な踊りなら\n 神さ: "How about it, isn't Lyla's dance great? With a dance this charming, even the gods would want to appear.
tm.「でも ひとつだけ 言っとくが\n ライラが あんまり キレイだからって\n 惚: "But one thing: don't fall for Lyla just because she's so beautiful, traveler.
tm.「ライラは 苦労して 結婚した\n オレのヨメさん なんだからな！: "Lyla is my wife, whom I worked hard to marry!
tm.「それなら いいんだけどさ。\n オレに わかることがあったら\n いつでも 聞: "Then fine. If there's anything I know, ask anytime!
tm.「トゥーラの音が 鳴らないから\n わしらの声で 神聖な あの音を\n 表現して: "The tula doesn't sound, so we express that sacred sound with our voices...
tm.「大地のトゥーラの修理も 終わり\n 余った おうごんのたてがみで\n すべての: "The earth tula's repair is done, and with the leftover golden mane we could repair all the tulas.
tm.「おかげで 今まで以上に すばらしい音色で\n 踊り子たちの ダンスのキレも\n: "As a result the tones are lovelier than ever and the dancers' moves keep getting sharper.
tm.「ありがとう これで ユバールの民の祈りは\n 二度と 絶えることなく\n 次の: "Thank you. Now the Yubar people's prayers will never cease and will be passed to the next age.
tm.「あら おひさしぶりね 旅の方。\n 前とは違って 私たちの\n おかしな様子に: "Oh, long time no see, traveler. You must be surprised at our strange state, unlike before.
tm.「私たち ユバールの民は\n 神の復活を祈り 音楽と踊りを捧げながら\n 各地を: "We Yubar people are wanderers who travel everywhere, offering music and dance in prayer for the gods' revival.
tm.「そして 今も 神への祈りを捧げる\n 神聖な宴の 真っ最中なのだけれど……。: "And now we're in the middle of a sacred feast offering prayers to the gods, but...
tm.「私たちの音楽に 必要不可欠な\n トゥーラという楽器の弦を 心ない誰かに\n: "Someone heartless cut every string of the tula, an instrument essential to our music.
tm.「仕方がないから 私たち踊り子は\n 演奏者の声を 楽器とする\n エアトゥーラ: "So we dancers dance to the air tula, where the musicians' voices are the instrument, but...
tm.「この先に控えている 神の復活を祈る儀式は\n ユバールの民に伝わる神器 大地の: "The ritual ahead to pray for the gods' revival must be danced to the earth tula, the Yubar sacred treasure.
tm.「神の復活こそ 我ら ユバール族の使命……。\n 切れた 大地のトゥーラの弦を: "Reviving the gods is our Yubar mission. Unless we repair the earth tula's strings, we can't fulfill it...
tm.「……それで あなたに お願いがあるの。\n 大地のトゥーラを 修理する\n お: "...So I have a favor. Would you help repair the earth tula?
tm.「……そうよね。\n 急に こんなことを言われても こまるわよね。\n ぶしつけ: "...I know. You must be troubled by such a sudden request. Please forgive my rudeness.
tm.「でも なんだか あなたなら\n 見つけられるかもしれないって 思ってしまって\: "But somehow I felt you might be able to find it... so I leaned on you.
tm.「……ありがとう 親切な 旅人さん！\n それでは 大地のトゥーラに張る\n 新: "...Thank you, kind traveler! Then I'll tell you about the new strings for the earth tula.
tm.「大地のトゥーラの修理に 使える弦は\n おうごんのたてがみという\n 世にも: "Only the very rare golden mane can be used to repair the earth tula.
tm.「ユバールの民に伝わる 伝承によれば\n 天を駆けるウマが住まう塔を守る 番犬が: "According to Yubar legend, the watchdog guarding the tower where the sky-galloping horse lives has that mane.
tm.「雲をつかむような話で ごめんなさい。\n もしも おうごんのたてがみが 手に入: "Sorry for the vague story. If you get the golden mane, please bring it to me.
tm.「大地のトゥーラを直すのに 必要な\n おうごんのたてがみの 正確なありかは\n: "We don't know exactly where the golden mane needed to repair the earth tula is.
tm.「ただ ユバールの民に伝わる 伝承によれば\n 天を駆けるウマが住まう塔を守る: "According to Yubar legend, the watchdog guarding the tower where the sky-galloping horse lives has that mane.
tm.「それしか 手がかりがなくて ごめんなさい。\n もしも おうごんのたてがみが: "Sorry that's the only clue. If you get the golden mane, please bring it to me.
tm.「旅人さん おかえりなさい！\n それで どうかしら。\n おうごんのたてがみは: "Welcome back, traveler! So, did you get the golden mane?
tm.ライラに おうごんのたてがみを 渡しますか？: Give the golden mane to Lyla?
tm.「……そう。大地のトゥーラの音色は\n エアトゥーラでは とても 表現できないの: "...I see. The earth tula's tone can't be expressed with the air tula. We need that tula.
tm.「私は いつまでも 待ってるわ。\n おうごんのたてがみを 手に入れたら\n 私: "I'll wait forever. When you get the golden mane, please bring it to me.
tm.「まあ 手に入れたのね！ すごいわ！\n ……これが おうごんのたてがみ。\n: "Oh, you got it! Amazing! ...So this is the golden mane. How beautiful.
tm.「これなら 大地のトゥーラの弦を\n 張りかえることが できるわ。\n 本当に: "With this we can restring the earth tula. Thank you so much.
tm.「ユバールの民を 代表して\n 私から 感謝の気持ちを送るわ。\n さあ これを: "On behalf of the Yubar people, I send you our thanks. Please take this.
tm.「あなたのおかげで 大地のトゥーラを\n 修理することが できたわ。\n 本当に: "Thanks to you, we could repair the earth tula. Thank you so much.
tm.「それに 余った おうごんのたてがみを使って\n すべてのトゥーラの弦を 張りな: "And with the leftover golden mane we restrung all the tulas, and they play better than before.
tm.「なんだか お腹の赤ちゃんも\n 美しい音色に よろこんでいるみたい。\n 私に: "Even the baby in my belly seems happy with the lovely sound. Like me, she must love dancing.
tm.「あのね ボクら ユバールの民が大切にしてる\n トゥーラっていう楽器の弦を\n: "You see, a bad person cut all the strings of the tula, the instrument we Yubar people treasure.
tm.「大きくなったら トゥーラ弾きになりたくって\n いっぱい れんしゅうしていたの: "I want to be a tula player when I grow up and practiced a lot, but at this rate I can't.
tm.「ふふふ！ トゥーラが直ったから\n ボク また 練習をはじめたんだ！: "Hee hee! The tula's fixed, so I started practicing again!
tm.「大きくなったら トゥーラ弾きになって\n ライラさんと 結婚するんだもん！\n: "When I grow up I'll be a tula player and marry Lyla! I'll work hard!
tm.「エアトゥーラに合わせて 踊るのは\n もちろん はじめてだけど\n 案外 イケ: "Dancing to the air tula is my first time, but it works better than expected!
tm.「私の中に流れる ユバールのリズムが\n 勝手に音楽となって 身体を動かすの！\: "The Yubar rhythm in me turns into music by itself and moves my body! Here we go, zun-doko, zun-doko!
tm.「エアトゥーラで 踊るのも\n なかなか 悪くなかったけれど\n 本物のトゥーラ: "Dancing to the air tula wasn't bad, but the real tula lifts my spirits more!
tm.「私の中に流れる ユバールのリズムが\n トゥーラの音色と ひとつになっていく～: "The Yubar rhythm in me becomes one with the tula's tone~! Here we go, zun-doko, zun-doko!
tm.「ここは ユバール族の休息地。\n 今は トゥーラの音色に合わせて\n 踊り子た: "This is the Yubar tribe's camp. Right now dancers dance to the tula's tone at a sacred feast.
tm.「……といっても たちの悪い\n イタズラのつもりか 知らねえが\n 村中のトゥ: "...Though some cruel prankster cut the strings of every tula in the village.
